senses.title: Kind and calm
senses.definition: kind, calm, and careful not to hurt anyone

senses.example: She spoke in a gentle voice to comfort the child.

senses.title: Soft, not rough

senses.why: A noble hand touches lightly rather than roughly.

senses.title: Not steep
senses.definition: rising or falling slowly, not steep

senses.exampleCN: 小路沿着一道缓坡向上。
senses.why: The idea of softness extends from touch to shapes in the land.

definition_en: a polite and well-mannered man, or a respectful way to address a man
core_image: 一位衣着整洁的男士为老人扶着门
scene: 一位绅士为老人打开了门。A gentleman opened the door for the old man.

definition_en: to obtain something, to become a certain way, to reach a place, or to understand

scene: 她终于得到了那份工作。She finally got the job she wanted.
sceneCN: 这里 get 是「得到；获得」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她终于得到了那份工作。

senses.title: Obtain
senses.definition: to receive or obtain something
senses.definitionCN: 接到或获得某物
senses.example: She finally got the job she wanted.
senses.exampleCN: 她终于得到了那份想要的工作。
senses.why: This is the oldest core sense: to come to have something.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的核心义：使某物来到自己手中。

senses.title: Become
senses.definition: to become or start to be in a certain state

senses.title: Reach

senses.why: Arriving is obtaining a place with your body.
senses.whyCN: 抵达就是用身体「获得」一个位置。

senses.title: Understand
senses.definition: to understand something, especially a joke or idea
senses.definitionCN: 理解某事，尤指笑话或想法
senses.example: I get the point now.
senses.exampleCN: 我现在明白这个意思了。

senses.title: Something given

definition_en: to hand something to someone, to donate, or to yield
core_image: 双手把一件东西递到别人面前
scene: 请把盐递给我。Please give me the salt.
sceneCN: 这里 give 是「递给」（第 1 个义项）；句意：请把盐递给我。

senses.title: To hand something over
senses.definition: to hand something to someone so they can have it

senses.example: Please give me the salt.

senses.title: To donate

intro.en: Give is an old Germanic verb with the same shape across many languages.

definition_zh: 高兴的；乐意的；令人高兴的
definition_en: pleased and happy, willing, or bringing joy

senses.title: Pleased

senses.definitionCN: 因某事而感到愉快
senses.example: I am glad to see you.

senses.title: Willing

definition_en: a quick look, to look quickly, or to read through briefly
core_image: 走路时目光迅速扫过街边的一扇窗
scene: 她朝窗外瞥了一眼。She glanced at the window.
sceneCN: 这里 glance 是「瞥一眼」（第 2 个义项）；句意：她朝窗外瞥了一眼。

senses.title: A quick look
senses.definition: a short look at something
senses.definitionCN: 朝某物匆匆看一眼
senses.example: She took a quick glance at the clock.
senses.exampleCN: 她匆匆看了一眼钟。
senses.why: The noun names the brief act itself.
senses.whyCN: 名词直接命名这个短暂的动作。
